<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1359
Claimant:
Alyssa Gutierrez
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
2023-04-15
Claim opened after a report that the insured vehicle was struck while turning left at an intersection. The claimant
reports a wrist injury from the impact and is represented by counsel, who has asked that all contact go through their
office.
2023-06-07
Confirmed that the driver is named on the policy and that the policy was in force on the reported date. Requested the
police report and photographs from the scene.
2023-07-02
Police report received. It confirms the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of the collision, and the responding
officer's account matches the reported manner of impact.
2023-08-12
Scene photographs reviewed. They show the points of contact and confirm several details of the reported collision,
though they do not show the moment of impact itself.
2023-08-16
Attempted to locate independent witnesses through the police report and the scene canvass. None were identified, so
the account rests on the parties and the physical evidence.
2023-08-18
Medical records received showing a wrist fracture. The kind of fracture and the force it implies are consistent with the
reported crash.
2023-08-23
Treatment followed a usual course, with follow-up visits tapering as the calimant improved. No earlier injury to the
same body area appears in the records we have obtained so far.
2023-08-24
Claimant's account was taken aagin through counsel. The description of the collision and the injury has stayed the
same in every conversation so far.
2023-09-19
Prior vehicle records were pulled. They show major damage to the same areas from an earlier accident that was
never reported to us, and the current claim presents that damage as new.
2023-10-16
Reviewed the overlap between the earlier damage and the current claim. It is not yet clear whether all of the claimed
damage came from this impact. Ntohing so far suggests the damage occurred before coverage began.
2023-10-31
Referred to the supervisor for a decision on next steps. Further inquiry is needed on the prior damage and the extent
of the current loss before any settlement discussion with counsel.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
